chunks.rationale: Read first: WorkSuggestion/WorkSuggestionStatus, ThreadInfo.suggestions, fork worktree flag, threads.resolveSuggestion, issues.create. Everything else implements this.
The store semantics: hypothesis-ledger pattern, open-title dedupe, 20-cap, never-reopen statuses, worktree flag under forkWorkerThread's guards, prompt note gated on coder-threads.
risks: recordSuggestion drops the OLDEST suggestion past the cap even if it is open and the newest are resolved

chunks.rationale: The agent-facing seam: MCP tool with project guard, immediate detail push so chips appear mid-run, note joins the dispatch chain.
risks: refreshDetail pushes even when no window is subscribed; harmless but unmeasured

chunks.rationale: Channel seam written by two different workers: threads:resolveSuggestion and issues:create must match string-for-string on both sides (verified by ipc-seam test + orchestrator join check).
gh issue create with no --label (missing label hard-fails), number parsed from printed URL, plan:todo via best-effort setPlanStatus after creation.
risks: URL/number regex trusts gh stdout shape; a gh output change degrades to ok:false, never a crash

chunks.rationale: The three actions: start = fork(worktree:true)+startRun+resolve(started); file = issues.create+resolve(filed); dismiss = resolve(dismissed). Current run is never touched.
risks: start-a-thread is three awaited IPC calls with no rollback: a startRun failure leaves a forked idle thread and an unresolved chip (user can retry or delete)

chunks.rationale: Quiet chip row at the bottom of the transcript, open-status only, in-flight ids disable the row's buttons; data-suggested-work/data-suggestion-action test hooks.
Read after impl: cap/dedupe/status-transition coverage, chip render + click + disabled-while-pending, seeded dev fixture.

risks: Two workers built the two sides of the IPC seam against the shared contract; the orchestrator merge ran the full suite plus a manual channel-name join check rather than trusting either side's mocks

The [Suggested work] prompt note ships to every provider whenever coder-threads is registered — chip volume depends on agent compliance with the 'at most a few per run' line, and nothing rate-limits beyond the 20-cap and open-title dedupe
